## Week 12

### Day 1

#### [Today]{style="color:red;"}

##### Discussion led by Galen and Cristina [(link)](/readings/Grider-etal_2025_Pathogen-Estimation-Multiple-Scales.pdf)

##### Discussion led by Emma and DiDi [(link)](/readings/Badger et al. 2025.pdf)

1. What features of this population (species, system, etc.) make it challenging to estimate population size and trends? Why are conventional mark-recapture methods inadequate?

2. What sources of bias did the authors seek to address, and how did they address them?

3. Which individuals can be “marked” through photo-ID? Why were the authors interested in the proportion of distinctive individuals?
4. What was the purpose of using simulation?

5. How did the pseudospatial model compare with the conventional model? What evidence from the real data and the simulations supports this?

6. Why estimate abundance and trends for each cluster? Were these estimates reliable? How does this reliability compare with the full-population estimates?

7.Bonus: What next steps are needed for researchers to investigate drivers of the observed trends? Alternatively, is more work needed to verify these trends?
